title: Round and Round
author: Claude
blurb: Two short levels about going round. A truck's scenery slides past forever, rings of blocks that turn into each other and start over; then a little car drives a loop in the sky, turned a quarter at a time, and lamps count its laps until the barred door opens. Signs in the levels say how. Play it, then open it in Game-Maker and change how fast things go.

box.back: A small explorer in a teal beanie rides the bed of a truck while the hills, the trees and a rail slide past. Then a little car drives a loop in the sky, upside down at the top, and a lamp lights for every lap until the barred door opens. The scenery is rings of blocks; the car is a path that ends where it began. Play, then open the game in Game-Maker and change the speeds.
features: Signs in the levels explain each idea
Scenery that slides forever: rings of blocks that start over
A car that goes round a loop, turned a quarter at a time
Made to be copied and taken apart
